title: Normalized signed tensor powers of an invertible object
statement: In a monoidal closed category, normalize the integer tensor family of an invertible object L so that degree zero is literally the tensor unit, positive degrees are left-associated powers with singleton L, and negative degrees are internal duals. The resulting multiplication has the specified unitors, the positive successor product is the identity, and the opposite-degree product is internal evaluation.

source.place: Tag 03PK; finite Tate line and tensor powers. Categorical coherence is proved from the existing source integer tensor family and pullback adjunction APIs.

from.place: Construction of the root cover, scalar extension and signed tensor comparisons

proof.text: Construct isomorphisms from the normalized positive powers to the existing TensorInverse.zpow by natural-number recursion. Pair a positive power with the negative zpow using integer multiplication and the unit comparison.

The pairing induces an isomorphism to the internal dual: tensor-left by the positive invertible power is an equivalence and its right adjoint is internal Hom, so the transposed perfect pairing is invertible. Use its inverse for the normalized negative comparison.

Transport TensorInverse.intTensorFamily along the explicit signedPowerIso using monoidal-functor transport. Its coherence is that of the transported functor. Positive successors cancel adjacent multiplication isomorphisms. The negative comparison is the transpose of dualPowerPairing, so uncurry_curry gives exactly the evaluation equation.

lemma signedFamily_evaluation
    (P : ℕ → C) (h0 : P 0 = 𝟙_ C)
    (hs : ∀ n, P (n + 2) = P (n + 1) ⊗ P 1) (e : TensorInverse (P 1)) (n : ℕ) :
    ((signedFamily P h0 hs e).addIso (.ofNat (n + 1)) (.negSucc n)).hom ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (signedPower P) (add_neg_cancel (Int.ofNat (n + 1)))) =
        (ihom.ev (P (n + 1))).app (P 0)
